name: Remove a redundant barrier, retain the necessary one
description: One CTA of 64 threads exchanges two 32-element halves of disjoint uint32 input/output arrays (256 bytes each). Two consecutive CTA barriers separate shared writes from shared reads. Test one-barrier deletions with the fixed launch and all six configurable assumptions disabled. Preserve all computation and memory instructions. Minimize static barrier count while retaining synchronization acceptance. Fewer barriers is a structural change, not a measured speedup; GPU and numerical-equivalence checks are not performed.
